title: How to Map an array and create new values easily
question:
In Pyspark, without having to explode the array, convert values using withColumn, then collect_list() to re package the array, say I have this data:

I want to map/do something to convert the values:

so the new array is like this:

How can I do this more easily?

Nothing yet, Need help with a starting point
answer:
If your mapping is a python dictionary, you can use a udf to apply the mapping to your array column elementwise:

arrayMap = {'a':'z','b':'y','c':'x','d':'w','e':'v'}
array_udf = F.udf(lambda arrayCol: [arrayMap.get(k) for k in arrayCol], ArrayType(StringType()))
df = df.withColumn('newArray', array_udf(F.col("Array")))

Result:

+---------------+---------------+
|          Array|       newArray|
+---------------+---------------+
|[a, b, c, d, e]|[z, y, x, w, v]|
|      [a, b, c]|      [z, y, x]|
|         [a, e]|         [z, v]|
+---------------+---------------+
